# ui-chat

The chat buffer: transcript, pending panel, queue, attachments and compose box.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui-chat.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui-chat.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** [ui](ui.md)
- **Required by:** [ui-access](ui-access.md), [ui-cache](ui-cache.md), [ui-cache-warm](ui-cache-warm.md), [ui-children](ui-children.md), [ui-compact](ui-compact.md), [ui-handoff](ui-handoff.md), [ui-linking](ui-linking.md), [ui-merge](ui-merge.md), [ui-priority](ui-priority.md), [ui-supervisor](ui-supervisor.md), [ui-tool-slots-load](ui-tool-slots-load.md)
- **Brings along:** [acp](acp.md) (its file requires it), [ui-compose](ui-compose.md) (its file requires it), [ui-pending](ui-pending.md) (its file requires it)

## About

One buffer per session, "*harness: NAME*", laid out top to bottom:

  header line   name, model, permission mode, non-interactive (only
                while it is on), thinking, context, cost, menu, after what
                `harness-chat-header-functions` put in front (a BTW's
                buttons); what the buffer shows already, it leaves out
  transcript    one block per node, rendered incrementally with markers
  top           what `harness-chat-top-functions` draw, first in the
                tail: the companion pet, standing on whatever comes next
  queue         messages queued for the next turn, each drawn as the
                user message it will be, "queued" and its buttons on
                its sender line
  activity      while a turn runs, what it does and for how long, on a
                background of its own, then a blank line
  pending panel permission requests and questions waiting for the user;
                a question whose options have diagrams shows one of
                them at a time, in one place, and switches between them
  todos         the session's todo items, one per line, or folded
  attachments   chips for files attached to the next message
  notice        the session was deleted, or is inactive (sending resumes it)
  compose       an editable region; C-c C-c sends, RET adds a newline
  mode line     status (the spinner while a turn runs), turn duration

The transcript is never re-rendered on a delta: every node owns a
region delimited by two markers, streaming text is appended at the
end of the live node's region, and a block is rendered through the
Markdown renderer only when it is finalised or at most every
`harness-chat--render-interval` seconds.  Thinking, tool calls,
compaction summaries and runs of coalescable tools (with the thinking
between their calls) collapse under overlays that isearch opens, so
every word of the conversation stays searchable; a hand_in call that
succeeds opens expanded once its result is in, its body the report
the task handed in.  History loads lazily: the newest
`harness-chat--history-limit` nodes at open, an older page whenever a
window scrolls near the top, and blocks far above every window are
dropped again so a long session never fills the buffer.

Region bookkeeping: every block's text ends with a separator newline
that is never deleted, so re-rendering a block replaces the text
before that newline and the markers of neighbouring blocks stay put.
The region above the transcript and each coalesced summary line use
the same trick.

Everything goes through the ACP connection held by `harness-ui`;
this file never touches a session struct.

## Provides

### Hooks

- `harness-chat-header-end-functions` — Functions adding segments of their own to the chat header line.
- `harness-chat-header-functions` — Functions putting segments in front of the chat header line.
- `harness-chat-panel-functions` — Functions putting a panel of their own below the transcript.
- `harness-chat-send-functions` — Functions run with the TEXT and ATTACHMENTS of each message sent.
- `harness-chat-tool-body-functions` — Functions giving a tool call block a body of their own.
- `harness-chat-top-functions` — Functions putting something at the top of the tail, first below the transcript.
- `harness-ui-decision-functions`

### Commands

- `harness-chat-allow-newest` — Answer the permission request at point, else the newest, with Allow.
- `harness-chat-approve-denied-call` — Approve the denied call whose block point is on.
- `harness-chat-cancel` — Cancel the running turn.
- `harness-chat-copy-last-response` — Copy the agent's last message (raw Markdown) to the kill ring.
- `harness-chat-copy-link` — Copy a link to the message or tool call at point to the kill ring.
- `harness-chat-copy-session-link` — Copy a link to this session to the kill ring.
- `harness-chat-delete-steering` — Delete the queued message ID, which the model has not got yet.
- `harness-chat-deny-newest` — Answer the permission request at point, else the newest, with Deny.
- `harness-chat-edit-permission-pattern` — Edit the glob pattern the permission request PID is answered for.
- `harness-chat-edit-queued` — Edit the queued message ID: it comes back into the compose box.
- `harness-chat-edit-steering` — Take the queued message ID back into the compose box, to edit it.
- `harness-chat-next-action` — Move point to the next tool call or thinking block.
- `harness-chat-next-diagram` — Show the diagram of the next option of the question waiting with diagrams.
- `harness-chat-next-message` — Move point to the next real message.
- `harness-chat-next-user-message` — Move point to the next message of your side of the conversation.
- `harness-chat-previous-action` — Move point to the previous tool call or thinking block.
- `harness-chat-previous-diagram` — Show the diagram of the previous option of the question waiting with diagrams.
- `harness-chat-previous-message` — Move point to the previous real message.
- `harness-chat-previous-user-message` — Move point to the previous message of your side of the conversation.
- `harness-chat-push` — Run the action of the button at point, or at the position of mouse EVENT.
- `harness-chat-queue` — Queue the compose box for the next turn.
- `harness-chat-redraw` — Render this buffer again from the harness.
- `harness-chat-remove-queued` — Delete the queued message ID: a message of the queue leaves it.
- `harness-chat-reposition` — Show this session in POSITION instead.
- `harness-chat-scroll-down` — Scroll the chat nearly a window toward its start, by pixels.
- `harness-chat-scroll-to-bottom` — Show the newest messages and put point in the compose box.
- `harness-chat-scroll-up` — Scroll the chat nearly a window toward its end, by pixels.
- `harness-chat-search` — Search the transcript incrementally, opening collapsed blocks on a match.
- `harness-chat-send` — Send the compose box, or answer the active question with it.
- `harness-chat-send-queue` — Send every queued message now.
- `harness-chat-send-queued` — Send the queued message QID now; the others stay queued.
- `harness-chat-tab` — Complete in the compose box; elsewhere expand or collapse the block at point.
- `harness-chat-toggle-block` — Collapse or expand the block ID (default the one at point).
- `harness-chat-toggle-group` — Show or hide the tool calls of group GID (default the one at point).
- `harness-chat-toggle-todos` — Show or hide the session's todo list above the compose box.
- `harness-open-latest-session` — Open the newest session of the current project in POSITION.
- `harness-open-session` — Open session ID in POSITION.
- `harness-prompt-region` — Prompt a session with the region: start a message in its box with it.
- `harness-up-to-parent` — Show the session this one was started from, and return its buffer.

### Options

- `harness-chat-agent-label` — Sender name shown at the start of each agent turn.
- `harness-chat-session-label` — Sender name shown above the messages the agent of another session sent.
- `harness-chat-system-label` — Sender name shown above the messages the harness sent on its own.
- `harness-chat-user-label` — Sender name shown above the user's messages.
